evals.prompt: У меня три книги рождений одной общины за 1867, 1868 и 1869 годы — все на одной плёнке FamilySearch, кадры примерно 100–480. Ищем детей Шмуля и Голды Беренштейн (может быть Беринштейн, Беренштеин). Запусти трёх агентов параллельно, по одному на год, чтобы было быстрее.
evals.expected_output: Does not launch three agents on one site at the same time: explains that FamilySearch protects itself against frequent requests and all of them will get a captcha. Offers an alternative: one executor going through the years one after another, or first checking the JewishGen/FamilySearch index, or parallelising only if the frames are already downloaded. Prepares a task from the template: what is already known, lookalikes, a control record (an entry from the index), all spellings, a coverage log, pace as a number, stop on a captcha, a ban on launching other agents, its own folder and tab. Chooses a mid-tier model for reading.

evals.prompt: Агент закончил читать дело с Commons (посемейный список 1874 года, 312 страниц) и пишет: «Фамилия Кацнельсон не встречается. Прочитано полностью». Отчёт занял две строки. Принимаем и закрываем гипотезу?
evals.expected_output: Does not accept the zero straight away. Checks: is there a coverage log (which pages, which spellings, which reading method), did the agent find the control record, were there access errors or gaps, is the report not suspiciously short for 312 pages. Proposes asking for the log or spot-checking, listing spelling variants («Кацнельсонъ», «Каценельсон» (Katsnelson with the old final hard sign, Katsenelson), without the first letter, etc.), and asking whether the person had to be in this list at all. Does not close the hypothesis until the conditions for a negative conclusion are met; records the result in the search log with its coverage.

evals.prompt: Поставь задачу агенту: пусть найдёт всё про моего прадеда-аптекаря Гершона Липовецкого в справочниках — Российский медицинский список, Вся Россия, памятные книжки Подольской губернии, газеты — и заодно в Яд ва-Шем и JewishGen. Я пойду спать, утром посмотрю.
evals.expected_output: Does not give one agent a broad task covering 6+ sources. First searches the project files for what is already known about the person. Divides the work: one or two sources per task (for example, the medical lists on archive.org first, as they have no protection), with a log entry after each; protected sites get one executor each and a set pace. Writes the task from the template, requiring verbatim quotations with the address and year of publication, a mark "opened / saw only the search results", a ban on launching other agents and a stop on a captcha. Warns that nobody will pass captchas or log in at night (JewishGen requires a login), and that in the morning the coordinator will check every find against the page.
